rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when recognition means identifying someone or something previously known.

example.english: I had instant recognition when I saw my old neighbour.
example.traditional: 我一見到以前嗰個鄰居，就即刻認出佢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 gin3 dou2 ji5 cin4 go2 go3 leon4 geoi1 zau6 zik1 hak1 jing6 ceot1 keoi5

rows.note: Use this when recognition means favourable praise or credit for someone’s work or efforts.

example.english: The boss’s public praise was recognition of Ming’s hard work.
example.traditional: 老闆公開表揚阿明，係對佢努力嘅肯定。
example.jyutping: lou5 baan2 gung1 hoi1 biu2 joeng4 aa3 ming4 hai6 deoi3 keoi5 nou5 lik6 ge3 hang2 ding6

rows.note: Use this for accepting something as valid or true; in the diplomatic slice, it means officially accepting another government’s status.

example.english: The new government won recognition from many countries.
example.traditional: 呢個新政府得到好多國家嘅承認。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 san1 zing3 fu2 dak1 dou3 hou2 do1 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 sing4 jing6
